full_prompt_en: A square surreal illustrated portrait shows a white-haired elder in a tall hat holding a small pipe, with pale swirling forms and a distant imagined town behind him. The background is a patchwork of muted blue, sage, cream, lavender, and warm beige, rather than a realistic sky. On the left, broad white curls drift upward like stylized smoke, their ribbons outlined by faint shadows. Low on that side, tiny pale towers and clustered roofs recede into a hazy settlement. The man fills the center and right, shown from the chest upward in left-facing three-quarter profile. His tall hat has a wide brim and bands of ochre, gold, and muted violet blocks. Wisps of white hair curl out from both sides beneath it. His face is long, angular, and deeply lined, with an arched brow, narrowed eye, prominent nose, and firm mouth. Warm peach, ochre, and rose planes shape the skin, while cool lavender shadows deepen the wrinkles. He holds a small dark pipe in his right hand near the lower left of his face; the thin stem reaches toward his mouth. A deep teal scarf folds around his neck and shoulder, set over dark blue clothing with a mustard-brown cravat at the center. Curving ornamental lines in the hair, smoke, face, and scarf give the image a continuous flowing rhythm, while the distant town remains much simpler. The finish is smooth but visibly painted, with softly blended planes and fine internal contour lines. Diffuse warm light from the upper left brightens the hat band, forehead, hand, and white curls, while teal and violet shadow holds the right side. The overall composition is whimsical and contemplative, pairing a severe sculptural profile with airy pastel swirls and a small dreamlike distance.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形超现实插画肖像描绘一位白发老人戴高帽、手持小烟斗，身后是浅色旋绕形状与远处想象中的小镇。背景由暗蓝、鼠尾草绿、奶油、薰衣草紫与暖米色拼成，而不是写实天空。左侧宽阔白色卷线像造型化烟雾向上飘，丝带状边缘由淡影勾出。左下方，细小浅色塔和屋顶群退入朦胧聚落。老人占据中央和右侧，从胸部以上以朝左的四分之三侧面出现。高帽有宽檐和赭、金、暗紫色块组成的帽带，白发从帽下两侧卷出。脸狭长、折角多且皱纹深，有高拱眉、眯起的眼、突出鼻梁和紧闭的嘴。暖桃、赭与玫瑰色平面塑造肤色，冷紫阴影加深皱纹。他的右手在脸左下附近拿着一只小深色烟斗，细烟嘴伸向嘴边。深青绿围巾绕过颈部与肩部，罩在深蓝衣服上，中央有芥棕领饰。头发、烟雾、脸与围巾中的弯曲装饰线给图像连续流动节奏，远处小镇则简化得多。完成面平滑但仍可见绘画性，有柔和调开的平面与纤细内部轮廓线。漫散暖光从左上进入，照亮帽带、额头、手和白色卷形，青绿与紫色阴影稳住右侧。整体构图奇趣而沉思，将严肃雕塑般侧脸与通透粉彩旋线及小小梦境远方配在一起。
style_prompt_en: The surreal illustrative treatment blends sculptural angular planes with flowing ornamental curls. Muted teal, sage, pale cream, lavender, ochre, and warm rose meet in softly graded patches, while narrow dark contours give the focus firmness. Repeated spiral and ribbonlike lines connect disparate areas into a continuous rhythm; small distant forms are simplified and pale. Surfaces appear smoothly painted but retain fine internal marks, especially where warm light crosses folded or raised planes. Diffuse upper-side illumination makes cream and gold areas luminous, with cool violet-blue shade sitting in creases and along one edge. The composition balances a heavy dark side mass against open pale movement on the other. Its overall effect is imaginative, polished, and gently theatrical.
style_prompt_zh: 这种超现实插画处理把雕塑般折角平面与流动装饰卷线调和起来。暗青绿、鼠尾草、浅奶油、薰衣草紫、赭与暖玫瑰色在柔和渐层色片中相遇，狭窄深色轮廓让焦点坚实。重复螺旋和丝带状线条把分散区域接成连续节奏；远处小形体简化且浅淡。表面看似平滑绘成，却保留纤细内部痕迹，尤其在暖光跨过折叠或隆起平面处。来自上侧的漫射光使奶油和金色区域发亮，冷紫蓝阴影落入折缝并沿一侧分布。构图以一侧沉重暗块平衡另一侧开放浅色运动。整体效果富想象、完成度精细而轻带舞台感。
theme_en: A white-haired elder holding a pipe amid swirling pale shapes
theme_zh: 白发老人手持烟斗，周围浅色形状旋绕
name: Oleg Shuplyak
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
